Package com.privatechain.storage.fs

package com.privatechain.storage.fs
File-system storage backend — persists each block as an individual JSON file in a configurable directory (FR-STOR-05).

FileSystemStorage writes block index n to <dir>/block-<n>.json using BlockSerializer. It requires no native libraries and is therefore portable across all JDK 17+ platforms.

All file path inputs are sanitized before use; SpotBugs PATH_TRAVERSAL_IN findings are suppressed with documented justification where the sanitization cannot be expressed in a form the interprocedural analyzer can verify statically.

Thread safety: writes are serialized via a ReentrantLock; reads use a shared ReadLock (FR-STOR-06).

Since:
1.0.0
